title: Pimenta de Castro's authoritarian government
summary: General Pimenta de Castro was appointed head of government in January 1915, suspended parliament and governed by decree with the Democrats excluded and monarchists readmitted to public life. Accounts differ on how far the president acted on his own initiative and how far he was pushed by the Democrats' opponents.
